items.followUp: Explain how sharing a printer on a network is useful.

rubric.why: A complete definition identifies shared access to one hardware device by multiple computers over a network.
rubric.description: Explains that several networked computers can use the same hardware device.
rubric.how: Award 2 marks for clearly describing shared access; award 1 mark if only the network or shared-device idea is stated.

rubric.why: A relevant device example shows what hardware can be shared.
rubric.description: Names an example of hardware that can be shared.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a suitable example.

rubric.why: A valid benefit explains why sharing hardware is useful.
rubric.description: States that sharing can reduce costs or make a device available to multiple users.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a valid benefit.

modelAnswer: Hardware sharing allows several computers on a network to use the same hardware device.
Examples of shareable hardware include printers, scanners, and storage devices.
Sharing reduces the cost of buying a separate device for every computer and makes the device available to multiple users.
